decision.summary: Two candidate temporary offsets identified in allowed context [560,670]. First (560–570): multi-axis transient with partial but incomplete recovery—return ambiguous, status uncertain. Second (599–634): sharp, axis-asynchronous step onset with sustained offset and no observed return; though coherent across axes, absence of opposing return prevents confirmation as temporary—status uncertain. No interval meets full criteria for confirmed temporary offset (onset, sustained interior, and clear opposing return).

intervals.observation: N drops ~−10 MAD at index 560, E drops ~−5 MAD by 562, U spikes +10 MAD then falls to ~−3 MAD by 564; all axes show partial recovery: N rebounds by 565, E by 567, U by 568, but none fully return to pre-560 levels by 570. Return is incomplete and ambiguous within allowed context.

N steps down ~−10 MAD at 599–600, holds near new level through 634; E steps down ~−5 MAD over 604–607, stabilizes; U drops sharply ~−6 MAD at 599–601, then remains near new level with minor fluctuations. No opposing return observed in any axis up to 634; sustained offset persists without reversal.
